name: camayoc_dora_deployments
description: DORA deployment frequency and change failure rate inputs (aegis-rb3): deployments of one service in a window, by outcome, from aegis:DeploymentEvent. Deployment frequency is the succeeded count over the window; change failure rate is (failed + rolledback) / all. Times are compared as RFC 3339 UTC strings, so producers must emit Z times.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?outcome (COUNT(DISTINCT ?event) AS ?deployments) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?artifact) AS ?artifacts) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?event a aegis:DeploymentEvent ; aegis:deployedService ?service ; aegis:deploymentOutcome ?outcome ; aegis:occurredAt ?at . OPTIONAL { ?event aegis:artifactId ?artifact } } FILTER(STR(?service) = CONCAT("http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/", "{service}") && STR(?at) >= "{start}" && STR(?at) < "{end}") } GROUP BY ?outcome ORDER BY ?outcome

params.name: service
params.description: deployed service local name, e.g. quipu
